messages:
noah (newhire): hey everyone, first morning and i can't reach analytics.internal:5000 from my laptop. WireGuard says connected but tcp hangs. any ideas? :wave:

tara: welcome! are you on IPv6 enabled network by any chance? we saw issues where clients had IPv6 default route and return path went v6, while our infra expects IPv4.

noah (newhire): interesting - i'm on a dual-stack home ISP. traceroute shows first hop is IPv6. here's `traceroute analytics.internal`: 
```
traceroute to analytics.internal (2001:db8:aaaa::1), 30 hops max
 1  2001:db8:1::1  1.2 ms
 2  2001:db8:ffff::1  10.4 ms
 3  * * *
```

sam-netops: that confirms DNS is returning an AAAA for the service and your system prefers IPv6. Our internal analytics cluster doesn't have IPv6 listeners; the IPv6 path is hitting an internet-facing anycast that drops the SYN. Check `dig analytics.internal AAAA`.

noah (newhire): `dig analytics.internal AAAA` returns 2001:db8:aaaa::1. so DNS has both A and AAAA. i didn't expect AAAA for internal host.

kevin: we added AAAA in the split-DNS for internal host for future IPv6 rollout but it isn't routed into the dev VPC yet. until we flip the infra, simplest fixes: 1) force host to prefer IPv4: add `precedence ::ffff:0:0/96 100` to /etc/gai.conf (linux) or on mac `sudo networksetup -setv6off <service>`; 2) remove AAAA from internal split-DNS for dev hosts (infra change). For now, try `curl -4 http://analytics.internal:5000` to confirm.

noah (newhire): `curl -4` works! thanks. can we avoid this for other new hires? broke my morning.

sam-netops: sorry about that. i'll open a ticket to roll back AAAA for dev and add an onboarding step: `curl -4` smoke test and `dig A/AAAA` check. ops-bot will create a ticket.

ops-bot: TICKET NET-12045 created: "dev split-DNS AAAA causes IPv6 return-path failures for new hires" assigned to eng-infra.

tara: also adding a one-liner to the onboarding doc: `if curl times out, try curl -4 and run dig +short A AAAA`. noah, could you open a tiny docs PR with the cmds you ran? we'll merge.

noah (newhire): yup will do. thanks all! :tada:

kevin: follow-up CHORE ENGINF-4500 created to add a gating smoke test that ensures dev hosts either have IPv6 listeners or no AAAA in the dev split-DNS.

ops-bot: CHORE ENGINF-4500 created and linked to NET-12045.
